prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: horizontal 3:2 project gallery photograph for a Chilean home-construction landing page. Primary request: a different, highly realistic residential quincho in La Araucanía, Chile. Scene: modest completed outdoor quincho beside a typical Chilean one-story family home, on a concrete slab in a green yard with native trees. Subject: sturdy treated-pine posts and beams, simple dark corrugated zinc roof, brick parrilla with chimney and a built masonry counter, a wooden table; believable construction joints, hardware, slightly weathered materials and natural imperfections. Composition: eye-level 35mm documentary architectural photograph from the front-left corner, whole quincho visible, natural proportions, enough room around structure for gallery crop. Lighting: soft clear late-afternoon light after rain, realistic shadows, natural color, no dramatic grading. It must look like an authentic photograph of a build in southern Chile, not a luxury European terrace or 3D render. No people, no text, no logo, no watermark, no fake signage.
